mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_questionnaire_completion (user_id, first_completed_at, last_submitted_at, submission_count) VALUES (#{userId}, NOW(), NOW(), 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_submitted_at = NOW(), submission_count = 1
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.gender AS gender, u.region AS region, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.matching_questionnaire_completed_at AS completedAt, c.last_submitted_at AS lastSubmittedAt, c.submission_count AS submissionCount FROM user u INNER JOIN user_questionnaire_completion c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE COALESCE(u.matching_questionnaire_completed, FALSE) = TRUE ORDER BY c.last_submitted_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
